Overview: Romeo y Julieta Wide Churchills

The Romeo y Julieta Wide Churchills is a robusto name for its vitola, with a 55 ring gauge and measuring 130mm in length. The Wide Churchill is a new creation, being shorter and fatter than the classic Churchill or Julieta No. 2. it was  release in 2010 and come available in boxes of 25.

wrhapped in a beautiful Colorado wrapper, the aroma that floats off the wrapper is a mild toast scent, while the cold draw is filled with cedar and baking spices.

Once lit the flavours off the top are a delicious blend of pepper and coffee with a touch of vanilla sweetness all wrapped into a thick creamy smoke that comes rushing out of the perfectly smooth draw. We found flavours of fruit, leather and baking spice in the second third, with some additional flavours of citrus and floral notes introducing themselves in the final third, closing out with an extra dose of coffee, nuts and pepper.
